description: DeepSeeNet AREDS Simplified Severity Score model for age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Takes one left-eye and one right-eye color fundus photograph and returns the patient-level AREDS Simplified Severity Score (0-5), derived from per-eye drusen size, pigmentary abnormality, and advanced AMD risk-factor classifiers.
disease: age-related macular degeneration, AMD, drusen, pigmentary abnormality, advanced AMD
